scenario: LCYC.2.2.1 — three-rule emit chain forming a cycle A→B→C→A is rejected with DS_VALIDATE_RULE_CYCLE. Complements LCYC.3.3 (two-rule cycle) by exercising the multi-hop detection path. Rule a emits X→Y; rule b matches Y emits Z; rule c matches Z emits X, closing the loop.
rules_ds:
schema X scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Y scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Z scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule a:
    X
->
    emit Y logical v: 1

rule b:
    Y
->
    emit Z logical v: 1

rule c:
    Z
->
    emit X logical v: 1
